# apple v0.6.0 - Table of Contents

Utilities for building Apple SDKs.

## Pages

- [Apple](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Apple](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.md): Utilities for building Apple SDKs.

- Types
  - [Apple.Types.AppStoreConnect](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.Types.AppStoreConnect.md): Provides App Store Connect related types.

  - [Apple.Types.AppleDeveloper](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.Types.AppleDeveloper.md): Provides Apple Developer API related types.
  - [Apple.Types.AppleMusic](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.Types.AppleMusic.md): Provides Apple Music API related types.

  - [Apple.Types.CloudKit](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.Types.CloudKit.md): Provides CloudKit API related types.

  - [Apple.Types.Developer](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.Types.Developer.md): Provides Apple Developer related types.

  - [Apple.Types.DeviceCheck](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.Types.DeviceCheck.md): Provides DeviceCheck API related types.

  - [Apple.Types.GameCenter](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.Types.GameCenter.md): Provides Game Center API related types.

- Service-specific utilities
  - [Apple.AppStoreServerAPI](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.AppStoreServerAPI.md): Utilities for [App Store Server API](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appstoreserverapi).

  - [Apple.AppleDeveloperAPI](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.AppleDeveloperAPI.md): Utilities for [Apple Developer API](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/appstoreconnectapi/profiles) via App Store Connect API.
  - [Apple.AppleMusicAPI](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.AppleMusicAPI.md): Utilities for [Apple Music API](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applemusicapi).
  - [Apple.CloudKitAPI](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.CloudKitAPI.md): Utilities for [CloudKit API](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/cloudkit/).
  - [Apple.DeviceCheckAPI](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.DeviceCheckAPI.md): Utilities for [DeviceCheck API](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/devicecheck).
  - [Apple.GameCenterAPI](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.GameCenterAPI.md): Utilities for [Game Center API](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/gamekit).
  - [Apple.MapKitJSAPI](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.MapKitJSAPI.md): Utilities for [MapKit JS](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/mapkitjs).
  - [Apple.MapsServerAPI](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.MapsServerAPI.md): Utilities for [Maps Server API](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/applemapsserverapi).
  - [Apple.WeatherKitRestAPI](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.WeatherKitRestAPI.md): Utilities for [WeatherKit REST API](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/weatherkitrestapi).

- Misc utilities
  - [Apple.Signed](https://apple.hexdocs.pm/Apple.Signed.md): Utilities for handling signed payload.
